meta.title: Zona Arqueológica Teuchitlán o Guachimontones | Guachimontones
meta.description: Explore the Zona Arqueológica Teuchitlán o Guachimontones in Jalisco, Mexico. Discover the stunning pre-Hispanic circular pyramids and the rich history of this archaeological zone.

intro.title: Explore Guachimontones
intro.description: The Zona Arqueológica Teuchitlán o Guachimontones is located in the municipality of Teuchitlán, Jalisco, Mexico. It is a unique archaeological site famous for its stunning pre-Hispanic circular pyramids. This site represents one of the most notable examples of pre-Columbian circular architecture in Mesoamerica, offering visitors a fascinating window into the ancient Teuchitlán culture.

visitGuide.title: Visiting Tips
items: The site is open to the public, verify opening hours before visiting
Hire a local guide for detailed information about the site's history
Bring hat, sunscreen, and water as there is little shade
Visit the site museum to see archaeological artifacts and models

alsoKnownAs.title: Highlights
items: Circular pyramids: One of the extremely rare circular stepped pyramid complexes in Mesoamerica, showcasing the unique architectural features of the Teuchitlán culture.
Cultural heritage: An archaeological site officially recognized and protected by INAH (National Institute of Anthropology and History).
Living history: Explore ruins of an ancient civilization dating back to 300 BCE (Late Preclassic period).
Prime location: Located in Jalisco state, easily accessible from Guadalajara.

sections.title: Historical Significance
sections.content: Guachimontones is an archaeological site of the Teuchitlán culture, which flourished between 200 BCE and 400 CE. The site is famous for its distinctive circular structures, including circular pyramids with altars at the top, circular plazas, and ball courts.

sections.title: Archaeological Landscape
sections.content: The site is located in a beautiful natural setting with views of the Sierra de Tequila. The circular structures are surrounded by typical vegetation of Jalisco, creating a unique atmosphere where history and nature meet.

sections.title: Visiting Experience
sections.content: Visiting Guachimontones is a fascinating experience. You can walk among the ancient circular pyramids, learn about the Teuchitlán culture at the site museum, and enjoy the stunning views of the surrounding landscape.

basicInfo.title: Basic Information
basicInfo.addressValue: Piramide circular, Carretera Estatal 604 Guadalajara-San Marcos Gral. Lucio Blanco, Estanzuela, 46762 Guachimontones, Jal., Mexico

hours.title: Opening Hours
hours.winterTime: Dry Season (November-April) is ideal for walking and exploring
hours.warningTime: It is recommended to prioritize calling ahead to verify special holiday arrangements before visiting.
hours.tip: Arrive early to avoid intense heat and crowds

tickets.title: Ticket Information
tickets.outdoorPrice: Prices are subject to the latest on-site announcements; it is recommended to call ahead for current ticket prices and discount policies.

transport.title: Transportation
transport.airportDesc: Nearest airport: Guadalajara International Airport (GDL). From there, rent a car or take ground transportation to Teuchitlán.
transport.selfDriveDesc: From Guadalajara, take State Highway 604 towards Teuchitlán. The site is well signposted.
transport.busDesc: Buses from Guadalajara Central Bus Station to Teuchitlán. From the local bus station, take a taxi to the archaeological site.
transport.intercityDesc: Several tour operators offer tours from Guadalajara that include transportation and guide.
transport.cyclingDesc: It is recommended to visit by private car or organized tour for greater comfort.
transport.tipsDesc: Jalisco is a wonderful state with rich culture, history, and traditions. Guachimontones is an archaeological gem you can't miss.

route.title: Visiting Route
steps: Arrive at the archaeological zone and visit the site museum for historical context
Explore and admire the unique structure of the Main Circular Pyramid (Piramide circular) from close up (Note: Climbing is strictly prohibited to protect the ruins)
Walk through the circular plazas and visit the pre-Hispanic ball court ruins
Enjoy panoramic views towards the Sierra de Tequila
Visit the magical town of Teuchitlán and try local cuisine
Return to Guadalajara and visit the Historic Center or the Rotonda de los Jaliscienses Ilustres
supplements: The site has parking and basic services
It is recommended to hire an official guide for a more enriching experience
Bring enough water and sunscreen, especially in hot season

items.name: Carlos Mendoza
items.text: An impressive and unique place in the world. The circular pyramids are fascinating and the site museum is very informative. Highly recommended for history lovers.

items.name: María González
items.text: Fascinating visit. I had never seen circular pyramids before. The guide was very knowledgeable and explained everything about the Teuchitlán culture. An excellent educational experience.

items.name: Juan Pérez
items.text: Very interesting archaeological site, although more shade and services are needed. The circular pyramids are impressive. Bring plenty of water and hat.

items.name: Ana Rodríguez
items.text: A unique place in Mexico. The circular pyramids are an architectural marvel. The site staff very friendly and the museum is very well maintained.

items.name: Roberto Silva
items.text: Very good archaeological site. A bit far from Guadalajara but worth the trip. The circular structures are unique in Mesoamerica.

items.name: Laura Martínez
items.text: Beautiful archaeological site. I loved the circular architecture and the views of the surroundings. Ideal to go with family and learn about pre-Hispanic history.

items.name: Miguel Ángel
items.text: Interesting historical site. The main circular pyramid is impressive. Better signage is needed on the road from Guadalajara.

items.name: Sofía Herrera
items.text: A hidden archaeological gem in Jalisco. The circular pyramids are unique in the world. A must-visit if you are in Guadalajara or Teuchitlán.
